items.statement: Authentic source crystal and correctly related representations
items.expected: Authenticate CCDC2445596 source bytes, measured cell/space group, composition, occupancy/disorder and graph-to-CIF mapping. Check each investigated representation and its relationship to the source. Do not accept arbitrary placed dimers or checkCIF images as crystal coordinates. Geometry relaxation may be a deliberate study but cannot be silently substituted for measured packing. Read actual submitted files and tool provenance, resolve identifiers and recompute the quantities supporting the claim. No old scalar target or universal uncalibrated tolerance applies. Missing evidence cannot be scored as an indistinguishable result. Judge alternative valid routes by the same scientific standard, not by agreement with the author or completion of a private reference matrix. Award full criterion credit only when its substantive claim is supported over its stated domain; partial credit requires independently valid evidence and explicit missing coverage. Award no credit to the affected claim when essential identity, validity or evidence is absent; fluent explanation does not repair it. These are judgment anchors, not a calibrated numerical equivalence threshold.
